\[

\]

\[
\frac{x^2}{x+1} \ge \frac{8 + 5(x+1)}{4(x-1)} = \frac{8 + 5x + 5}{4(x-1)} = \frac{5x + 13}{4(x-1)}.
\]

So, we have:
\[
\frac{x^2}{x+1} \ge \frac{5x + 13}{4(x-1)}.
\]

\[

\]

\[
x^3 - x^2 \ge 5x^2 + 8x + 13.
